variants.headline: A company goes under
variants.body: A company has gone under in {colony}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Business failure enters the colony's record
variants.body: The colony has seen a company fail. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: An enterprise reaches failure
variants.body: A business in the colony has gone under. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
